observation: A first full pytest found one failure because an audit copy of release-v1.json was temporarily placed in the main training jobs directory. That directory test intentionally passes every JSON to the strict training validator; the release descriptor is correctly rejected.
resolution: Keep the immutable original descriptor at its actual transport source commit b137418e jobs/release-v1.json; main keeps the byte-exact audit copy as results/publication-spec-v1.json. No training validation was weakened and no test was changed.
followup: New full pytest is executing against the corrected artifact placement.
